entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We're sorry for sneaking in so many[n]times, Boss.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: There's no mistaking it. This is the same[n]door as in the Palace.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hello, Futaba? You're there, aren't you?[n]Please answer us.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I doubt she'd answer...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Alibaba, we know you're there. It doesn't[n]matter if it's through chat messaging.[n]Just answer us.

entries.speaker: Alibaba
entries.en: You should've told me you[n]were going to come here.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: In order to steal your heart,[n]we need you to open this door.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We can't change your heart[n]otherwise. Please let us in.

entries.speaker: Alibaba
entries.en: I'm not mentally prepared!
You have to do this.
Get ready right now then.

entries.speaker: Alibaba
entries.en: That's easy for you to say...

entries.speaker: Alibaba
entries.en: It's too sudden.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: The other you within your heart[n]told us to have you open it.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Deep down, you want to open[n]this door, don't you?

entries.speaker: Alibaba
entries.en: The other me?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Right.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We're trying to uphold our promise,[n]but you're the one resisting us.

entries.speaker: Alibaba
entries.en: Give me some time.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Ten seconds.

entries.speaker: Alibaba
entries.en: That's too short! At[n]least minutes. Please!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Fine. But if Boss comes home, we'll kick[n]down the door and enter if we must.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Time's up, Alibaba.

entries.speaker: Alibaba
entries.en: All right, I'll open it now.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We need to change her cognition.[n]Better to be completely safe than sorry.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: So she has to be the one to invite us in...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Futaba, please open the door.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: All right, let's go in...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: What is this...?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Medical science, information[n]technology, biology, psychology...[n]These are all technical books...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: She keeps herself cooped up in a room[n]like this all the time?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Where's Futaba?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Where could she be hiding?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: The closet!?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: She'll shut herself in to the bitter[n]end, hm?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Even if that door's opened up, we'll get[n]stopped again inside.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I bet a fence or something formed[n]right in front of the Treasure now.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Th-This makes no sense! Explain[n]yourselves!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Whoa, she talked...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We needed to change your cognition.[n]Unless we do so, we can't steal your[n]heart.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I highly doubt she would understand it[n]even if we explained it to her...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: So basically, my cognition is being[n]a hindrance, keeping you away from[n]the core of my cognitive world?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Huh? She understood it?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Why do you know about that?[n]Who are you?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Why'd you call yourself Alibaba and[n]make things more complicated?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: If you wanted help, you could've just[n]asked for it.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: ...was ...rrassed.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Huh? M-My bad. I didn't catch that.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: ...'Cause I was embarrassed.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I think I get it.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Asking someone for help isn't that easy...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Futaba, can you tell us more? How do[n]you know about the cognitive world?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: ...'Cause I knew about it.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh... That reminds me. Boss was talking[n]about "cognition" or something before,[n]right?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You think this is related to how he was[n]gettin' grilled by that one lady?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Perhaps her mother was researching this[n]cognitive science that was mentioned?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: "Cognitive psience," with a PSI in front![n]Less science, more supernatural.[n]That's important.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Well that certainly got her attention...[n]It seems we're on the right track.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: So, cognitive... psience? Futaba,[n]what was your mother working on?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Please tell us. What happened?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: She's not answering.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yo, maybe save this for later. Seems[n]she's been through some serious shit,[n]so... you know?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: True... She did say things like "die"...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Hold on.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Futaba-chan. Did you really kill your[n]mother?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Whoa, you moron!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wasn't her death an accident?[n]What actually happened?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: "Maternity neurosis"? Is that really true?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Ann.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We saw what your heart is like, but we[n]still can't figure anything out.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: The mother that Boss told us about is[n]completely different from your cognition.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We want to hear the truth from your[n]mouth.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: ...M-My mom... was...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: The... one who killed her... was... Nngh...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It's possible that she can't remember[n]because her heart has become distorted.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I'm so sorry, Futaba-chan.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It's just that... I went through[n]a lot myself, and I... I'm sorry.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Th-There! Now steal it!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...What's gotten into you all of a sudden?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: C-C'mon, hurry it up!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We did come to steal your heart, but[n]it's not really done right here at this[n]moment...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: All you really had to do was open that[n]closet door...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...I'm sorry we made you jump to[n]conclusions. You don't have to be[n]like that...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I-I see...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: She went back in!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: ...Wh-What's the meaning of this!?[n]D-Did you guys trick me?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: No! Please listen! There's a reason[n]we had to do this!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: She's aware of the cognitive world, but[n]it seems she doesn't understand how[n]a change of heart occurs.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Um, Futaba, how much do you know[n]about the cognitive world?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I know that there's another world[n]based on cognition. But I don't know[n]how to get there.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Can you guys go there? You said[n]you "saw my heart" earlier.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Yes, that's right.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: How do you do it?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We use a smartphone app.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: An app?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Yes. By entering the required[n]information, we can go to[n]the cognitive world.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: A name, a place, and a distortion—those three.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So in this case, "Futaba Sakura,"[n]"Sojiro Sakura's house," and—

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Futaba, you don't happen to have this[n]app, do you?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: This...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: ...I don't.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Thank goodness... Okay then.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Can you take me with you too?
No.
What should we do?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I gotta agree. Just leave this to us.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Why're you even askin'? Of course[n]she can't come with us.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I'll leave it to you then.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Good. And you better not forget about[n]our promise, all right?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh yeah! Almost forgot!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: The Treasure's not gonna appear if we[n]don't have her read this!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Hm? A calling card?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It's the one you prepared. Read it.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: ...I can't read it. It's too dark.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You could just come out...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: ...It's embarrassing.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I'll make sure she reads it, so you guys[n]go on ahead.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Futaba, make sure you read it, okay?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: ...Okay.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Let's see...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Futaba Sakura has committed a great sin[n]of drowning in sloth.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: ...Thus, we will rob every last bit of those[n]distorted desires.

entries.speaker: Shadow Futaba
entries.en: No. I'm going to die...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Good.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Eek!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Kitty! You again!?
